[[N's Castle]] }} '''Cold Hard Truth''' (Japanese: '''ゼクロムVSレシラム I''' ''Zekrom VS Reshiram I''), titled '''Zekrom VS Reshiram I''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 520th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 60th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}. It is subtitled '''Zekrom VS Reshiram I''' (Japanese: '''居城''' ''Lord's Castle'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Cold Hard Truth''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== With {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Reshiram}} awakened, {{adv|Black}} descends into the {{un|Pokémon League}} Stadium and confronts [[Zinzolin]], having received the "all clear" from [[Kimi]] as the spectators have all been evacuated. Meanwhile, [[Brycen]] attempts to investigate a mysterious underground facility after losing contact with {{adv|White}}, only to come across the kidnapped [[Hawes]] and the [[Seven Sages]], including [[Ghetsis]]. Calmly, Zinzolin activates a button that deploys the Team Plasma Castle, causing the superstructure to rise up from the ground around the Pokémon League and the army of {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s to start descending on the crowd of spectators. Sensing Reshiram's awakening, {{adv|N}} prepares to appear with {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom}}; Reshiram likewise detects its opposite and roars at the sky. The Seven Sages descend from the castle, dropping off Hawes in front of Black. Ghetsis declares Team Plasma's victory: N defeated the Pokémon League Champion, [[Alder]], Team Plasma taken over the league, and cemented their ideals as superior to those of the Gym Leaders, who have been tied to crucifixes and put on display. Reshiram flies towards N, ready to confront its counterpart. Angered at Team Plasma's actions, [[Marshal]] insists to his [[Elite Four]] comrades that now is the time to strike, but before they can get closer on [[Shauntal|Shauntal's]] {{p|Golurk}}, Hood Man appears and releases the {{adv|forces of nature}} to battle the Elite Four. [[Grimsley]] declares that he's going after Hood Man and asks his allies to handle the Legendary Pokémon, as Hood Man muses to himself that he'll soon unlock the Pokémon's Therian Formes. As his Pokémon stand off against the Seven Sages, Ghetsis mocks Black and the decision before him: will he save the Gym Leaders or confront Zekrom? As his {{p|Hydreigon}} fends off Black's Pokémon, Ghetsis assures Black that neither is an option for him: Reshiram has abandoned Black to fight Zekrom, [[Drayden]] and [[Iris]] are busy protecting the spectators from the Team Plasma Grunts, Alder is missing and the Elite Four are fighting the Forces of Nature, meaning nobody is left to take on Team Plasma. However, a chorus of voices announce their intent to rescue the Gym Leaders, retorting that they have the capability because of their dreams and love for Pokémon. The voices are revealed to be the friends and allies Black made on his journey: {{tc|Hiker}} Andy, [[Shoko]], {{tc|The Riches}} Trish, {{tc|Janitor}} Geoff, {{tc|Doctor}} Logan, {{tc|Baker}} Chris, and {{tc|Biker}} Jeremy, who have gathered to make an assault on Team Plasma. ==Major events== * {{adv|Black}} demands that [[Zinzolin]] tell him where [[Colress|Hood Man]] took {{adv|White}}. * [[Brycen]] digs down to find Team Plasma's castle, but is defeated and captured by [[Ghetsis]]. * Zinzolin summons [[N's Castle]] from beneath the {{un|Pokémon League}}. * [[Team Plasma]] begins marching out. * The captured [[Gym Leader]]s are hoisted up on crucifix-like objects as a display of Team Plasma's power. * {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Reshiram}} senses {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom}} and leaves Black behind to fight its counterpart. * The [[Elite Four]] attempt to face Team Plasma, but they are interrupted by Hood Man, who uses {{DL|Forces of nature
